default.$description: Standard surface: cards, panels, the header.

disabled.$description: Surface of a disabled card or field.

raised.$description: One floor above default: popovers, raised panels.

inverse.$description: The opposite surface: tooltips, dark chips.

sunken.$description: Recessed wells: fields, tracks, code. See-through, so a well always shows one step below what it sits on: the page, a card or a panel.

translucent.$description: See-through glass over pictures and busy backgrounds.

overlay.$description: Floating panels opened from a control: the dropdown and select list, the combobox list, the date picker and the popover. One step above surface/raised, so a menu opened in a modal, a drawer or on a card stands apart. Dialogs (modal, drawer, command palette) stay on surface/default. Not see-through (that is surface/translucent).

track.$description: The filled track of a switch that is off: 3:1 against the page so the switch shows where it is (decision C).

skeleton.$description: Skeleton shapes: translucent, so they show by the same step on the canvas, default, raised and sunken surfaces in both themes.

hover.$description: A row or option under the pointer or the keyboard highlight: menu options, table rows. Translucent, so it works on any surface.

track-subtle.$description: The empty part of a progress track: light enough that the fill stands out by lightness, not only by hue.

neutral-subtle.$description: A quiet neutral fill for small marks and their resting state (default badge, tag, chip): translucent, so it shows by the same step on the default, raised and sunken surfaces. Hover steps up to color/surface/hover.

thumb.$description: The knob of a switch: the same near-white in the light and the dark theme, so it reads as one knob on the red on-track (5.5:1) and on the grey off-track (3.5:1 light, 7.2:1 dark), above the 3:1 a control’s state needs. Used by: Switch. Falls back to color/surface/raised. Remove it if the thumb is to follow the theme again.

selected.$description: The current or chosen item, such as the current page in the sidebar. Translucent, so it shows by the same step on the default, raised, sunken and canvas surfaces.

scrim.$description: A dark band under light text over a picture, such as the words on a picture card. The same in both themes, so the text stays readable on any photo.

link-underline.$description: The line under a link at rest, see-through so it sits the same on every surface.

link-underline-hover.$description: The line under a link, on hover.

link-underline-pressed.$description: The line under a link, while pressed.

control.$description: The edge that marks a control: a checkbox, a radio (must reach 3:1).

brand.$description: Brand-red edge; also the logo’s mark.

groove-top.$description: Upper line of an engraved divider or rim.

groove-bottom.$description: Lower line of an engraved divider or rim.

rim.$description: The light rim that makes a surface look lit: fields, chosen pills, cards.

edge-shade-subtle.$description: A faint see-through dark edge inside a colour sample (swatches, colour sliders and areas, contrast samples), so any colour stands apart from the surface behind it.

focus-inverse.$description: The focus ring on brand surfaces (a brand chip or tag’s remove button), where the brand-red ring would vanish. Decision F.

on-media.$description: A light edge that stays light in both themes, for a ring drawn over any colour, such as the colour picker’s thumb.

background.$description: Brand button and chip: fill at rest.

background-hover.$description: Brand button and chip: fill on hover.

background-pressed.$description: Brand button and chip: fill while pressed, one step past hover.

background-disabled.$description: Brand button and chip: fill when disabled.

foreground.$description: Brand button and chip: label and icon at rest.

foreground-disabled.$description: Brand button and chip: label and icon when disabled.

border.$description: Brand button and chip: edge at rest.

border-hover.$description: Brand button and chip: edge on hover.

border-disabled.$description: Brand button and chip: edge when disabled.

background-pressed.$description: Neutral chip: fill while pressed or selected, one step past hover.

foreground.$description: Neutral chip: label and icon at rest.

background-pressed.$description: Secondary button: fill while pressed, one step past hover.

foreground.$description: Secondary button: label and icon at rest.
Outline button: label and icon at rest.

foreground-disabled.$description: Outline button: label and icon when disabled.

background-pressed.$description: Outline button: fill while pressed, one step past hover.
Ghost button: fill while pressed, one step past hover; also the current page in pagination.

foreground.$description: Ghost button: label and icon at rest.

background.$description: Dark chip and radio: fill at rest.

background-hover.$description: Dark chip and radio: fill on hover.

background-pressed.$description: Dark chip and radio: fill while pressed, one step past hover.

foreground.$description: Dark chip and radio: label and icon at rest.

border.$description: Dark chip and radio: edge at rest.

border-hover.$description: Dark chip and radio: edge on hover.

background.$description: Danger button and menu item: fill at rest.

background-hover.$description: Danger button and menu item: fill on hover.

background-pressed.$description: Danger button and menu item: fill while pressed, one step past hover.

background-disabled.$description: Danger button and menu item: fill when disabled.

foreground.$description: Danger button and menu item: label and icon at rest.

foreground-hover.$description: Danger button and menu item: label and icon on hover and while pressed.

foreground-disabled.$description: Danger button and menu item: label and icon when disabled.

border.$description: Danger button and menu item: edge at rest.

border-hover.$description: Danger button and menu item: edge on hover.

border-disabled.$description: Danger button and menu item: edge when disabled.

background.$description: Background of a disabled button, in every tone: a faint see-through grey, always fainter than an enabled button. Not for tracks: a disabled switch or slider part uses color/surface/track-subtle.

foreground.$description: The label and icon of every disabled action, shared by every kind of button.

border.$description: The edge of every disabled action, shared by every kind of button.

text-on-surface.$description: Success messages: text on the strong fill.

text-on-subtle.$description: Success messages: text on the pale fill.

icon.$description: The success tone’s own icon (a check), so the tone is never shown by colour alone.

text-on-surface.$description: Warning messages: text on the strong fill.

text-on-subtle.$description: Warning messages: text on the pale fill.

icon.$description: The warning tone’s own icon (a warning sign), so the tone is never shown by colour alone.

text-on-surface.$description: Danger messages: text on the strong fill.

text-on-subtle.$description: Danger messages: text on the pale fill.

border.$description: Danger messages: edge; the edge of a field in error (3:1).

icon.$description: The danger tone’s own icon (an alert sign), so the tone is never shown by colour alone.

text-on-surface.$description: Info messages: text on the strong fill.

text-on-subtle.$description: Info messages: text on the pale fill.

icon.$description: The info tone’s own icon (an info sign), so the tone is never shown by colour alone.

xs.$description: Shadow colour, xs: used inside the shadow styles.

sm.$description: Shadow colour, sm: used inside the shadow styles.

md.$description: Shadow colour, md: used inside the shadow styles.

lg.$description: Shadow colour, lg: used inside the shadow styles.

xl.$description: Shadow colour, xl: used inside the shadow styles.

scrim.$description: Dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

brand.$description: Brand-red icons, at the same contrast as brand text.

subtlest.$description: The quietest icons: hints and decorations beside placeholder text.

on-thumb.$description: The tick or cross inside a switch’s thumb: the same dark grey in both themes, 7.2:1 on color/surface/thumb. Used by: Switch (Icon on). Falls back to color/icon/subtle. Remove it together with color/surface/thumb.

series.$description: The single series colour; the same as categorical 1, so one series and the first of many agree. Light blue/600, dark blue/400. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

series-hover.$description: The single series, one step stronger, when pointed at or focused. Light blue/700, dark blue/300. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

1.$description: Categorical position 1 (blue). Fixed order, never cycled. Light blue/600, dark blue/400. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

2.$description: Categorical position 2 (orange). Light orange/500, dark orange/400. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

3.$description: Categorical position 3 (neutral). Light grey/700, dark grey/300. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

4.$description: Categorical position 4 (green). Light green/500, dark green/400. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

5.$description: Categorical position 5 (purple). Light purple/500, dark purple/300. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

6.$description: Categorical position 6 (teal). Light teal/600, dark teal/500. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

7.$description: Categorical position 7 (yellow). Light yellow/500, dark yellow/500. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

8.$description: Categorical position 8 (pink). Light pink/600, dark pink/300. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

1.$description: Sequential scale, low end (faint cells are outlined and carry their number). Light blue/300, dark blue/800. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

2.$description: Light blue/400, dark blue/700. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

3.$description: Sequential scale, step 3. Light blue/500, dark blue/600. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

4.$description: Sequential scale, step 4. Light blue/600, dark blue/500. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

5.$description: Sequential scale, high end: stands out most in both themes. Light blue/700, dark blue/300. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

low-2.$description: Diverging scale, far low end. Light orange/700, dark orange/300. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

low-1.$description: Diverging scale, low. Light orange/500, dark orange/500. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

mid.$description: Diverging scale, the neutral middle (3:1 on both themes). Light grey/500, dark grey/500. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

high-1.$description: Diverging scale, high. Light blue/500, dark blue/500. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

high-2.$description: Diverging scale, far high end. Light blue/700, dark blue/300. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

reference-line.$description: A threshold or target line across a chart. Light grey/800, dark grey/200. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: direct labels, markers or patterns too.

good.$description: A chart mark that shows a state that is fine: on target, healthy, done. Calmer than the feedback colors, which stay for badges, banners, icons and text, and never a series color. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: a label or an icon says the state too.

warning.$description: A chart mark that shows a state that needs watching: near a limit, slipping. Calmer than the feedback colors, which stay for badges, banners, icons and text, and never a series color. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: a label or an icon says the state too.

bad.$description: A chart mark that shows a state that is wrong: over a limit, failed, lost. Calmer than the feedback colors, which stay for badges, banners, icons and text, and never a series color. Marks reach 3:1 on the plot background; never colour alone: a label or an icon says the state too.

keyword.$description: Code: control flow and modules, such as import, export, from, return, if and await, and CSS at-rules such as @media. Light purple/600, dark purple/400. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

string.$description: Code: text in quotes. Light orange/600, dark orange/400. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

number.$description: Code: numbers, CSS lengths and colors, and true, false and null. Light green/600, dark green/300. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

function.$description: Code: function names, CSS functions such as var(), and the command a shell line runs. Light yellow/600, dark yellow/300. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

type.$description: Code: type, class and component names. Light teal/600, dark teal/400. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

property.$description: Code: keys and properties, such as object and JSON keys, CSS properties and custom properties, HTML and JSX attributes, and command flags. Light blue/800, dark blue/300. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

comment.$description: Code: comments, the quietest part of the code. Light grey/600, dark grey/400. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

punctuation.$description: Code: brackets, commas, colons and operators. Light grey/700, dark grey/300. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

declaration.$description: Code: words that declare or name, such as const, let, function, class, interface, type, new and this. Light blue/600, dark blue/400. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.

tag.$description: Code: HTML and JSX tags, and CSS selectors. Light blue/600, dark blue/400. Text: 4.5:1 or more on the code block's well, in both themes; color is never the only sign of what a piece of code is.
